profile_text.body:
Snowflake is a for-profit public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Bozeman, Montana, trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker SNOW. The company describes itself as operating an "AI Data Cloud" intended to support data engineering, analytics, application development, and AI workloads within a single platform. Its site says the platform covers the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and processing through modeling and application sharing, and that it also offers a Snowflake Postgres option designed to bring a relational database into that environment without requiring separate data pipelines.

On the AI side, Snowflake offers two tracked products. Snowflake Arctic is an enterprise-focused large language model released under the Apache 2.0 license with integration into the data cloud and support for commercial use. Snowflake Cortex is a native AI layer within the data cloud that provides LLM functions, vector search, data residency controls, and governance capabilities through a component called Snowflake Horizon.

SEC filings show the company reported revenue of approximately $4.68 billion for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, based on its most recent 10-K. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
